# Requirements Quality Checklist: GitHub Project Status Trigger — Board-Driven Agent Launches

**Purpose**: Validate that the feature's spec and plan are complete, consistent, unambiguous, and testable before `/speckit-tasks`
**Created**: 2026-09-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

These items test whether the requirements are *written* well — complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and fully covering the scenario space — not whether any implementation works. This complements the built-in [requirements.md](requirements.md) (spec-quality gate) by extending coverage to the plan and to gaps surfaced by cross-reading spec + plan.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for how the run is handed the issue body when the body is empty or absent (still a `:ro` file, or skipped)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a bound specified on the issue-body size written to the read-only file, or is the body written unbounded? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for a board item that is an issue in the target status but carries no Status value edge (null option) versus the matched option? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec state the GitHub token scopes/permissions `GITHUB_PROJECT_TOKEN` must hold to read the board? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the identity fields when a board item's repository (`owner/repo`) cannot be resolved from the item? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the behavior specified when two agents name the same board but different statuses, given "one shared query per board per tick"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for what appears in the run record / tags when an optional field (`label`, `repo`) is unset? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "within about a minute" quantified with a measurable upper bound tied to `interval_seconds`? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the source of an item's "first seen" / `entered_at` time defined (sensor poll time vs a GitHub-provided timestamp)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is oldest-first tie-breaking defined when two held issues share the same `entered_at`? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK011 Is case-insensitive status matching disambiguated when a board has two Status options differing only by case? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the 48-character feature-key cap defined as inclusive of the `NNN-` prefix (number + hyphen), so the slug budget is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the 256-char title cap ordering defined relative to control-character stripping, and is multi-byte-safe truncation specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "leaves the target status" defined to cover both a move to another status and removal from the board? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do the feature-key grammar and 48-char cap agree between spec §FR-011, the Assumptions, and plan §Constraints? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Plan]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the five `AGENTBOX_ISSUE_*` env names and five `agentbox/issue_*` tag names stated identically across spec §FR-012/§FR-013 and the plan? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the `interval_seconds` default (60) and floor (30) agree across §FR-001, the Assumptions, and §FR-023? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "active from launch until it leaves the status" stated consistently across US3, §FR-008, and the Edge Cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the run-key definition (`<item_id>:<entered_at>`) in the plan match the spec's exactly-once intent in §FR-006 without contradicting §FR-005 "forgotten on leaving"? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality & Measurability

- [ ] CHK020 Is every functional requirement (FR-001..FR-026) traceable to at least one measurable success criterion (SC-001..SC-010)? [Traceability, Measurability]
- [ ] CHK021 Can "the board token appears in none of the container env, tags, logs, or transcript" be objectively verified as written? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK022 Is there a measurable success criterion covering the UI round-trip / Automation-view behavior (US9, §FR-024..§FR-026), or only acceptance scenarios? [Gap, Measurability]
- [ ] CHK023 Is pagination (multi-page board, §FR-021) backed by a measurable success criterion, not just an acceptance scenario? [Coverage, Measurability, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the load-time validation failures (§FR-023) expressed with objectively checkable message content (names the file and field)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a daemon restart between emitting a `RunRequest` and the run being recorded (no double-launch, no lost launch)? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for whether the slot stays held when a launched run fails, errors, or is terminated while the issue remains in the status? [Coverage, Exception, Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK027 Is behavior specified for an item that enters and leaves the status entirely between two ticks (never observed in-status)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK028 Do requirements cover both agent kinds (job launched by name, asset materialized) for every launch-path scenario, not only launch? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK029 Are non-functional/resilience scenarios (GitHub error, rate-limit, timeout, unresolvable board/status/field) each mapped to a defined skip behavior? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, §FR-020]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK030 Is behavior specified when the same `project_item_id` re-enters the status before the prior run's slot has been released? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for an issue that is closed or deleted while sitting in the target status? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the empty-slug feature-key rule (`NNN` alone, no trailing hyphen) stated unambiguously for titles that are entirely punctuation/emoji/control chars? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the exclusion of PRs and draft items defined to also prevent them from holding the one-at-a-time slot, not just from launching? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, US4]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK034 Are polling rate-limit / API-budget requirements quantified against GitHub limits for the ≥30s cadence and per-board shared query? [NFR, Clarity, Spec §FR-021, Plan §Performance]
- [ ] CHK035 Are the read-only body file's permissions/mount mode (`:ro`) specified as a security requirement, and is the token's redaction path stated? [NFR, Security, Spec §FR-014, §FR-017]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 Is the assumption that the spec-013 handoff mechanism can be reused cleanly validated, with its stated fallback (env/tags only, agent fetches body)? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the dependency on outbound HTTPS egress from the `dagster-daemon` to GitHub documented as a requirement/precondition? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the "decisions to confirm" all resolved in Assumptions with no remaining `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers, and each labeled as a revisitable default? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]

## Traceability

- [ ] CHK039 Does every user story (US1..US9) map to at least one functional requirement and at least one acceptance scenario? [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK040 Is a requirement & acceptance-criteria ID scheme established and used consistently (FR/SC/US references) so items can be traced across spec and plan? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied; leave unchecked when a requirement still needs clarification or correction.
- `[Gap]` items flag requirements that appear absent — a satisfied review may resolve them either by adding the requirement or by recording an explicit, intentional exclusion in scope/assumptions.
- Product vocabulary (`triggers`, `on_project_status`, `AGENTBOX_ISSUE_*`, `agentbox/issue_*`, `project_status_<name>`, `GITHUB_PROJECT_TOKEN`) is used deliberately per AGENTS.md as the declarative operator surface, not as implementation detail.
- This checklist complements the built-in `checklists/requirements.md`; it does not replace it. `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
